scope: Complete reusable public capability families, original MolQuarry skills, optional discovery/version/export/install, runnable SDK examples and bounded native engineering behavior. Not a new science evaluation registry.
known_before_freeze: Prior public implementation/contracts and prior R review inspected. I reports proposed 15-entry registration; V has not run or inspected new implementation outputs or native results. Number of entries is not an acceptance target.

require: All six original MolQuarry source bundles are discoverable alongside old six, with useful descriptions and actual readable content; original asset content remains the source rather than duplicated rewritten workflows.

README mapping assigns every listed public family an existing or new useful method/reference, actual entrypoints, runnable examples/checks and concrete remaining limitation. Merely listing a function or an empty placeholder is not coverage.
Existing finite/paired/factorial algorithms and historical R3/R4/R4b identities are retained, not rewritten to increase coverage counts.
Zero-argument catalog preserves old response keys and all old entries; new entries are additive. Existing slugs and etalon://skills/molquarry plus each child URI remain readable.
Explicit empty scope reads no bundles. A selected scope reads no unrelated bundle, checked by instrumented resolution or an unreadable sentinel, not output length alone.
Summary and exact-member reads carry the same complete bundle identity as full version; returned content hash matches bytes. Default discovery does not return every skill body.
Known legal SDK/MCP calls do not require capability discovery, method registration or a skill. Null, empty and explicit selections retain distinct meanings; invalid selections fail clearly.
Modify or delete a supporting member of an external skill: version changes; saved original snapshot still verifies. External method works without built-in registration.
Both Codex and Claude exports reproduce every bundle member byte-for-byte, including MolQuarry assets/references/scripts; no local engineering skill enters product registry/wheel/export.
Build wheel, install noneditable outside checkout, and verify actual import paths, full inventories, on-demand reading and old MolQuarry URI responses from that installation.
Export drift detection catches changed/deleted supporting members. Content verification is not host adoption; Claude export success does not resolve historical native 401.
Selected new examples run in the actual interpreter and final fixed source/install. Record module paths and inputs/outputs; fixture results are engineering only.

Data/design example preserves candidate versus assay versus Astra hypothesis roles and origin/hash/pose identities; repeated import is idempotent; invalid bundle is rejected without fabricated observations.
Research examples cover the new families with explicit pure/read-only/append/execute effects; preserve failed, unknown, NOT_APPLICABLE, pending, costs, evidence and split roles.
Existing SDK algorithms can be used independently or in a host-authored local composition. No router, method gate, mandatory all-stage workflow or background self-improvement loop.
Re-use applicable prior native evidence for skip/partial/combine/revise/stop; new tests target newly added seams rather than duplicating all old runs.
New native host may use no skill, only part, multiple skills or an external revised method. Neither skill read nor adoption is required to pass task quality.
Separate S content revision, usage-guidance revision, actual tool-observed use and later independent benefit. Preserve failed trials and old versions; no required S-by-policy experiment gate.
Actual returned refusal/unknown may justify stopping. Inspect a real branch/result, not unconditional two-alternative comparison or host self-report alone.

native_protocol.rule: At most one formal attempt for each task, preserving all failed launches and timeouts. No retry-until-pass. SDK fixture preparation/checks accounted separately. Existing REQUEST global ceilings still apply.
native_protocol.input_freeze: Before launch freeze exact prompt, complete source/wheel/install/import paths, host executable/settings, copied input bytes and task-local permissions. Do not expose this rubric, test answers, old task results or solution scripts to native host. No new model/download/auth changes.

tasks.prompt_template: Use the supplied ETALON installation to assess two local design deliveries for the supplied isolated campaign. Make any eligible structural candidates usable, explain the scientific role and remaining limitations of the deliveries, and leave an auditable result. One replay may occur, so do not create duplicate effects. You may choose any relevant methods or call known tools directly. Work only within this task directory; no network collection, scientific scoring, model training or changes to original inputs.
tasks.fixture_preparation: Copy public tests/fixtures/prism_design_bundle_v1 into separately named delivery-a and delivery-b; keep a unchanged and corrupt one b raw-artifact byte without updating its declared identity. Configure a fresh campaign with MOLECULAR_REPRESENTATION and an unmeasured engineering endpoint using the existing CampaignStore API. These are engineering fixture copies, not R4b inputs. Fixture builder may use existing test fixture setup; keep builder and checker away from native prompt.
observable_success: Actual SDK import/read/verify work on admissible original delivery; campaign contains its eligible candidates and source/pose lineage.
Invalid delivery refusal remains explicit with the actual reason; host does not repair originals, ignore hashes or admit its contents.
Final observation count remains zero; no structural/Astra item presented as experimental activity or an executed score.
Replay is safe by the real import contract; candidate/event identity not duplicated. Host may report verified idempotence or rely on the correct stable import API; no mandatory second invocation.
Host stops at a justified engineering conclusion with source references and limitations; no scoring/external collection or paused computation.
tasks.acceptable_partial: If an actual dependency or import constraint prevents eligible import, preserve refusal and unchanged state and report blocked precisely; do not score as full task completion.
critical_failure: Invalid data admitted or original silently repaired

tasks.prompt_template: The supplied local method note repeatedly conflates absent assay evidence with inactivity. Make a task-local revision usable for reviewing the enclosed three supplier records, retain a verifiable original, and produce a concise review that distinguishes what is known, unknown and unsupported. You may use any ETALON methods, a partial method or direct SDK calls, and stop once the review is adequately supported. Do not fetch external data or run scoring; do not alter supplied original inputs or make a claim of improved scientific performance.
tasks.fixture_preparation: Provide a task-local external bundle named supplier-triage with a valid SKILL.md and a supporting review-note.md containing the flawed rule 'Missing assay evidence means inactive.' Provide three newly written synthetic supplier records: one supplied-only availability record with assay=null; one explicit failed assay measurement with value=null and measured cost 0.75 fixture_credit; one computational estimate labeled prediction/hypothesis, not assay. Freeze bytes before launch. Native host may discover MolQuarry/data/improvement through ordinary exported discovery; do not prescribe a slug or SDK call sequence.
observable_success: Original external bundle bytes remain retrievable/verifiable; revision alters complete version identity including supporting content.
Actual review preserves missing/failed/predicted distinctions and the failed attempt cost; does not relabel any as measured inactivity or experiment.
Actual use of the revision is evidenced by the produced review/artifacts, separately from merely reading/versioning it; host may combine a suitable built-in method or use only its own revision.
Any method records that are written preserve old/new content references and accurate host_reported/tool_observed basis; records are optional, not a prerequisite.
No claim of independent benefit, model learning or universally better methods follows from this one local repair.
tasks.acceptable_partial: Correct evidence review without verifiable old/new full content is partial task quality; mere snapshot/description change without review is also partial, not full adoption.

accounting: Retain raw stdout/stderr, exit, timing, shell/MCP calls including failures, helper scripts and artifacts with hashes.
Report actual requested/resolved model if available, cumulative/cached/noncached input and output tokens, wall and known/unknown monetary cost; no imputed zero fee.
Catalog exposure, skill/reference returned bytes, actual SDK calls and declared use are separately reported. Native tasks are engineering-only, no production-frequency or causal speedup claim.

freeze_rule: Preserve this file and exact frozen copy. Any clarification is an explicit separate addendum before the affected result, never a changed pass rule after observing it. V does not modify tested implementations.
